the Kinslayer]] has stats identical to the [[Divine Favor]] version of this item. *[[Gordac's Needle]] has stats identical to the [[Blood Magic]] version of this item. *[[Tain's Corruption]] has stats Haunter]] and [[Yamesh's Anguish]] have stats identical to the [[Illusion Magic]] version of this item. *[[Wieshur's Inspiration]] has stats identical to the [[Inspiration Magic]] version of this item. *[[Seacrash's Influence]] and [[Zarnas' Wrath]] have stats identical to the [[Earth Magic]] version of this item. *[[Prismatic Rod]] and [[Setikor's Scepter]] have stats identical to the Stonebreaker (wand)|The Stonebreaker]], and [[Antiquated Rod]] have stats identical to the [[Water Magic]] version of this item. *[[Podaltur's Fury]] has stats identical to the [[Channeling Magic]] version of this item. *[[Vengeance Seeker]] has stats identical to the [[Communing]] version of this item. *[[Oola's Wand]] has stats identical to the [[Restoration Magic]] version of this item. *[[Mossbeard's Wand]] has stats identical to the [[Spawning Power]] version of this item. == Notes == * The two versions of the Wayward Wand with [[HSR]] [[Healing Prayers]] or [[Protection Prayers]], both with an attribute requirement of [[Divine Favor]] and inflicting [[fire damage]], used to be available from the [[Adept of Light]] before they were replaced with the current Wayward Wands (Healing Prayers or Protection Prayers requirement both inflicting [[holy damage]]). Existing copies of the old versions remain unchanged. * Two versions of the Wayward Wand with HSR [[Inspiration Magic]], one with an attribute requirement of [[Domination Magic]] and one with an attribute requirement of [[Illusion Magic]], used to be available from the [[Adept of Illusion]] before they were replaced with the current Wayward Wand (Inspiration Magic requirement). Existing copies of the old versions remain unchanged. * The [[Spawning Power]] requirement version of the Wayward Wand with HSR [[Restoration Magic]] used to be available from the [[Adept of Spirits]] before it was replaced with the current Wayward Wand (Restoration Magic requirement). Existing copies of the old version remain unchanged. * Other items with this appearance: **{{any}} [[Wayward Wand]] ==Trivia== * The [[Soul Reaping]], [[Fast Casting]], and [[Energy Storage]] requirement Wayward Wands were not initially available when their respective collectors were introduced.
